_what: THE TITLE REGISTRY (2026-10-16). One formal title per report page: object + what was decided. `was` is the H1 the builder writes today and is the gate: design/titles.js refuses a page whose H1 is neither `was` nor `title`. `standfirst` is the demoted editorial line (null = none). `frozen`: the H1 is quoted by the method paper's bibliography and does not change. File names and URLs never change. `_instruments`: the same for the 22 cards of /instruments/, keyed by id; playground/build.js applies it to the index; since 2026-10-17 the same row retitles the instrument's own page (`pageWas` is its builder's H1 and the gate; the line is demoted to the standfirst unless `pageStandfirst` is null).

audits.title: Audits of machine-generated mathematics
audits.lede: Claims produced by AI systems and autonomous discovery platforms — releases, registries, manuscripts, announced records — re-decided from their published bytes, by programs that share no code with the claimant.

evaluation.title: Evaluation whose ground truth is a proof
evaluation.lede: Graders measured against provably wrong answers, answer keys re-decided, and environments and benchmarks in which a certificate replaces the answer key.

theorems.title: Theorems and exact values
theorems.lede: Results proved here in exact rational or outward-rounded interval arithmetic — the calibration of the instruments, and some values that were not known.

decisions.title: Certified decisions for operations
decisions.lede: Engineering and operational numbers decided over declared envelopes: aviation, maritime, energy, ocean statistics. Each page names what it does not claim.

record.title: The record
record.lede: What was decided month by month, what was refused and why, how to re-run any of it, and how a claim is submitted.
